```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
project <- params$project
project_name <- params$project_name
bundles <- if (is.null(project$bundles)) list() else project$bundles
```

# `r project_name`

## Project overview

- **Project:** `r project$name %||% project_name`
- **Experiments:** `r paste(omicsCore::experiment_tags(project), collapse = ", ")`
- **Sample link:** `r if (!is.null(project$sample_link)) paste0(nrow(project$sample_link), " mapping rows") else "none"`

```{r overview-table}
exp_tags <- omicsCore::experiment_tags(project)
if (length(exp_tags) > 0L) {
  rows <- lapply(exp_tags, function(t) {
    x <- project$experiments[[t]]
    data.frame(
      tag = t,
      omics_type = x$omics_type %||% NA_character_,
      assay_type = x$assay_type %||% NA_character_,
      n_features = nrow(x$expr_mat),
      n_samples = ncol(x$expr_mat),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, rows))
}
```

## Bundles

```{r bundles-section, results = "asis"}
if (length(bundles) == 0L) {
  cat("_No analysis_bundle objects attached to this project._\n")
} else {
  for (nm in names(bundles)) {
    b <- bundles[[nm]]
    cat("\n### ", nm, " (`", b$analysis_name, "`)\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Params:", length(b$params), "entries\n")
    cat("- Result keys: ", paste(names(b$results), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
    for (rk in names(b$results)) {
      obj <- b$results[[rk]]
      if (is.data.frame(obj) && nrow(obj) > 0L) {
        cat("\n**", rk, "** (top 10 rows)\n\n", sep = "")
        print(knitr::kable(utils::head(obj, 10L)))
      }
    }
  }
}
```
